pages.text: Computation glyphs are those which only interact with the capsum and its species. They may be simple, popping to number species, adding them together, and returning the output to the stack. They may also be more complex, reordering the species on the capsum, or creating a list species based on the species already stored in the stack.
These glyphs exist in a diverse variety, for more detailed discussion of this topic refer to the section $(l:lingua_mundi:computation_specifics)Specifics in Computation$().
